confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and coffee anchors rest on 2026 Korean price ranges from travel blogs and aggregators (CityCost, Expatistan, Korea Consumer Agency-cited coffee ranges), so they are moderate-quality. Beer, cocktail and wine are weaker: wine has no reliable 2026 source, so wine_glass is set from the local beer relationship (about 2x draft beer) and is low confidence. Cocktail is based on Seoul and Busan mid-range bar prices adjusted for Jeju. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Jeju's July peak-season guesthouse and hotel market; no booking pages or current listings were checked, so they are low confidence. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (20 March 2026), not a November 2026 value; I could not retrieve a current RBA observation, so the rate may be stale. Treat it as unverified against the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Korean mid-sized tourist-city price levels, anchored to Jeju-specific meal data (CityCost and local eatery reports) and Seoul/Busan bar and café price ranges. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Jeju guesthouse and hotel pricing and the July peak season.
